court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Imperial
case_search_note: ROA/Case Lookup by case number (linked from the court's ROA/Case Lookup page): public cases only; confidential and sealed cases are not available. Parties and attorneys can request document-level Online Case Access through the court's Public Portal (ecourt.imperial.courts.ca.gov/public-portal) with identity verification.

courthouses.name: El Centro Criminal Courthouse
courthouses.hours: Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; criminal offices open to the public Mon–Fri 8–4; phone and live chat Mon–Fri 8–4
courthouses.note: Court: the Criminal Division is in this courthouse. Criminal Court Clerk's Office (760) 482-2245, crimrecords@imperial.courts.ca.gov, criminal fax (760) 336-3593.

courthouses.name: El Centro Courthouse (Downtown)
courthouses.note: Traffic Division is here (payment window/phone 8–4 Mon–Fri). Also family law self-help, small claims, jury, law library. Court call center (760) 336-3500; remote appearances (760) 482-2273. Adult criminal cases are at the El Centro Criminal Courthouse.

courthouses.name: Winterhaven Court
courthouses.hours: Tue–Thu 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. (closed 11:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.); closed Mondays and Fridays
courthouses.note: Criminal Division page lists a Winterhaven criminal contact: (760) 336-3550. Exact case types heard here not listed.

public_defenders.name: Imperial County Public Defender
public_defenders.hours: Office closed to the public (per PD page)

legal_aid.name: ICSC Self-Help Access Center
legal_aid.what: Court self-help services for family law and certain civil cases (legal information and resources); also guided form filling and law library/Access Center appointments. Criminal record clearance help not listed.

probation.name: Imperial County Probation Department
probation.note: Press 0 for the front desk. Fax (442) 265-2376. Email icprob@co.imperial.ca.us (listed on Juvenile Services page).

programs.name: Ability to pay / MyCitations (infractions)
programs.summary: For infractions (including traffic): ask the court to consider ability to pay, a payment plan, more time, or community service — online via MyCitations or in person before fines are fully paid.

programs.name: Remote appearances
programs.summary: Court says your upcoming hearing may be eligible for remote appearance; remote appearance line (760) 482-2273.

programs.name: Criminal record copy requests
programs.summary: Request criminal record copies via the court's Contact form, phone or live chat (Mon–Fri 8–4) or crimrecords@imperial.courts.ca.gov. Fees: $0.50/page copies, $40 certification, $15 per search over 10 minutes.

programs.name: Sheriff Day Reporting Center (DRC)
programs.summary: The Sheriff's Corrections page has a DRC section.

jails.name: Regional Adult Detention Facility (RADF)
jails.phone_note: Jail & inmate information / visitation: (442) 265-2266 (Sheriff). Visiting rules PDF linked from the Sheriff jail page.
jails.note: Sheriff: everyone is first housed at RADF for medical screening and classification, then may stay or move to OFDF/HHCC; has male and female medical housing units. Address is the Sheriff's inmate mailing address.

jails.phone_note: Jail & inmate information / visitation: (442) 265-2266 (Sheriff). Visiting rules PDF linked from the Sheriff jail page. Working, programming sentenced inmates can earn in-person lawn visits.
jails.note: Sheriff: dormitory housing (314 beds), mostly working/programming incarcerated persons. Address is the Sheriff's inmate mailing address.
